args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in production across us-east, us-west and eu-west (healthy=false, error rate 18%). Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: us-east, us-west and eu-west now running v2.3.0. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before promotion. Follow-up: root-cause v2.3.1 and review why it was promoted.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west and failing health checks, with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. The system confirmed the rollback finished, and all three regions now run v2.3.0. I haven't checked health or error rate since, so it's worth confirming checkout-api is healthy again.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open as a SEV2 for checkout-api. It describes the failure, the rollback and the follow-up work.

Worth looking into: v2.3.1's release candidate was already unhealthy in staging before it went to production. The incident flags this so the root-cause review can cover why it was promoted.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
